name: lokatalenta-docs
description: LokaTalenta Documentation Hub: Architecture specs, ADRs, cross-app integration contracts, 6-division 24-agent matrix, and structured workflow rubrics.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,teal "tsx watch server/index.ts" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && npm --prefix client run typecheck
